documents.title: FY2026 GP forecast NOK 30M short of the double-digit ambition
documents.source_ref: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget (MyLINK CORE ambition)
documents.excerpt: Gross profit lands at NOK 1,690M (+8.2% on FY2025), NOK 30M (1.7%) below the NOK 1,720M ambition. Growth is broad across the five European markets; the gap is a mix issue, not a market issue.

documents.title: Conversational GP +30.8% — WhatsApp adds NOK 40M
documents.source_ref: SDP GP by product family — FY2026 forecast vs FY2025 actual
documents.excerpt: Conversational Channels grow GP to NOK 280M (16.6% of group GP). WhatsApp Business adds +NOK 40M on Meta per-message pricing and template migration; RCS grows +56% from a small base.

documents.title: Nordic operators raise A2P termination 5–7% from 1 January
documents.source_ref: Operator notices (Telenor, Telia, Telia Finland) — Carrier & Termination Cost phase
documents.excerpt: Termination cost is NOK 5,773M, 77% of revenue. Routing absorbs part of the increase; the remainder must be passed through in Enterprise SMS pricing to protect GP per message.

documents.title: Wholesale: 40% of volume, 7% of GP
documents.source_ref: SDP GP per message — 24.9bn messages, FY2026 forecast
documents.excerpt: Carrier Wholesale SMS earns 1.3 øre per message against 16.3 øre for conversational traffic. Every 1bn messages moved from wholesale to conversational adds about NOK 150M of GP at today's unit economics.

documents.title: Adjusted EBITDA NOK 680M — 40.2% of GP, gate passed
documents.source_ref: SDP GP & EBITDA Consolidation — 21 markets, 6 planning markets
documents.excerpt: Opex of NOK 1,010M (personnel NOK 640M, platform & cloud NOK 185M). The finance gate passes: within 5% of ambition and above the 38% EBITDA floor. Four legacy SMSC platforms migrate onto MyLINK CORE.
